example.en: Senior management will convene next Tuesday to review the corporate expansion roadmap.
example.zh: 高階管理層將於下週二召開會議，以審議企業擴張藍圖。

words.mnemonic: sen- (年長、老) + -ior (較...) ＝ 年資較深、職級較高的 (senior manager)。

example.en: Please attach a recent digital passport-style photo to your employee ID application.
example.zh: 請在您的員工識別證申請表上附上一張近期的數位證件照。

words.mnemonic: photograph 的口語簡寫：photo ID (附照片的身分證件)。

example.en: The supplier refused to accept return packages without prior authorization codes.
example.zh: 供應商拒絕接收未附帶事先授權碼的退貨包裹。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + fuse (流、倒) ＝ 倒流回去不收 ＝ 拒絕接受 (refuse to accept)。

example.en: Public transport connections between the international airport and downtown are excellent.
example.zh: 國際機場與市中心之間的大眾運輸交通連結十分便捷優質。

words.mnemonic: trans- (跨越) + port (攜帶、搬運) ＝ 跨區運送 ＝ 運輸物流。

example.en: Renewable energy has emerged as a major sector for sustainable corporate investment.
example.zh: 再生能源已崛起浮現成為企業永續投資的主要關鍵產業領域。

words.mnemonic: e- (出) + merge (浸入、沒入) ＝ 從水中浮出 ＝ 嶄露頭角、浮現。

example.en: The conference registration packet includes a color campus facility map.
example.zh: 大會報到資料袋內附有一份彩色會場園區設施地圖。

words.mnemonic: 地圖；動詞片語 map out (周詳規劃藍圖)。

example.en: Design engineers introduced an eco-friendly concept car at the automotive exposition.
example.zh: 設計工程師在國際車展上展示發表了一款環保概念車。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + cept (拿取、抓住) ＝ 在腦海中共同抓住的構想 ＝ 概念。

example.en: The luxury resort hotel is located on a private tropical island accessible by boat.
example.zh: 這間奢華度假飯店座落於一座私人的熱帶島嶼上，需搭乘渡輪接駁抵達。

words.mnemonic: 注意字母 s 不發音 (/ˈaɪlənd/)；商場展售常見 display island。

example.en: The financial services board initiated regulatory reforms to enhance market transparency.
example.zh: 金融監理委員會發起法規改革，以提升整體市場透明度。

words.mnemonic: re- (再) + form (成形) ＝ 重新塑造成更好的形狀 ＝ 改革。

example.en: Neither the project director nor the lead engineer could attend today's symposium.
example.zh: 專案主管與首席工程師兩位今天都無法出席研討會。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法題高頻必考：neither A nor B (A和B兩者皆不是)。

example.en: Our marketing firm purchased prime television commercial slots during the championship football game.
example.zh: 我們的行銷公司在美式足球冠軍賽轉播期間買下了黃金電視廣告時段。

words.mnemonic: 廣告贊助常考：football stadium (球場)、commercial sponsor (贊助商)。

example.en: Few independent retail shops survived the prolonged regional economic downturn.
example.zh: 極少數獨立零售商能在這場持久的區域經濟低迷中維持營運生存下來。

words.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + viv (生命、生活) ＝ 在苦難之上活下來 ＝ 生存、度過難關。

example.en: Passengers are requested to arrive two hours before their scheduled flight departure time.
example.zh: 請旅客於預定航班起飛時間前兩小時抵達機場航廈辦理登機手續。

words.mnemonic: 多益機場必考：flight attendant (空服員)、connecting flight (轉機航班)。

meaning: 剩下的(leave 的過去分詞)

example.en: Turn left past the security checkpoint to locate boarding gates twelve through twenty.
example.zh: 穿過安檢站後請向左轉，即可找到十二號至二十號登機門。

words.mnemonic: 方向指引：turn left (左轉)；庫存剩餘：two units left (剩下兩件)。

example.en: Our technical support team worked diligently to solve the customer's network issue.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援團隊克盡職責迅速解決了客戶的網路連線障礙。

words.mnemonic: 名詞 solution (解決方案)；solve a problem (解決問題)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters invited commercial neighbors to an open house community preview.
example.zh: 企業總部邀請周邊鄰近的商戶夥伴參加開放日社區預覽會。

words.mnemonic: 衍生詞 neighborhood (鄰里街區、周邊周遭)。

example.en: The candidate has an impressive academic and professional background in corporate finance.
example.zh: 該應徵者在企業財務領域具備令人印象深刻的亮眼學歷與專業工作背景。

words.mnemonic: back (後方) + ground (地面、根基) ＝ 身後的累積資歷 ＝ 背景。

example.en: Staff members will attend a training workshop to master modern project management techniques.
example.zh: 員工將參加培訓工作坊，以熟練掌握現代專案管理技巧。

words.mnemonic: techn- (技能、工藝) + -ique (名詞尾) ＝ 具體的操作技巧技術。

example.en: The corporate website redesign resulted in a forty percent increase in monthly web traffic.
example.zh: 企業網站的重新改版讓每月的網路造訪流量大幅增加了百分之四十。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：公路車潮 (heavy traffic) 或網站訪客量 (website traffic)。

example.en: Staff suggestions led to significant improvements in warehouse inventory workflow safety.
example.zh: 員工的提案建議促使倉儲庫存工作流程的安全防護獲得了顯著的改善。

words.mnemonic: improve (改善) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 改善措施、進步。

example.en: Our digital project management tool enables seamless real-time team collaboration.
example.zh: 我們的數位專案管理軟體工具實現了流暢無間的即時團隊協作。

words.mnemonic: 實體工具或數位應用工具：analytical tool (分析工具)、software tool (軟體工具)。

example.en: Failing to fulfill safety compliance regulations may carry severe legal consequences.
example.zh: 未能嚴格履行安全法規標準可能將承擔嚴重的法律後果。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + sequ (跟隨) + -ence ＝ 隨之而來的後續結果 ＝ 後果。

example.en: Under no circumstances should confidential customer data be disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
example.zh: 在任何情況下，均嚴格不得將機密客戶資料外洩給未經授權的第三方。

words.mnemonic: circum- (環繞) + st (站立) + -ance ＝ 環繞在周圍的客觀局勢 ＝ 情況。

example.en: The corporate building policy strictly prohibits employees from smoking on the premises.
example.zh: 企業辦公大樓規章嚴格禁止員工在大樓場所範圍內吸菸。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與安全警報必備：smoke detector (煙霧偵測警報器)、non-smoking room (禁菸房)。

example.en: Initial consumer market reaction to the newly launched beverage line has been overwhelmingly positive.
example.zh: 消費者市場對這款新上市飲品系列的初期反響呈現壓倒性的正面好評。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + act (行動) + -ion ＝ 對外界刺激做出的反向動作 ＝ 反應。

example.en: The outdoor company summer picnic was relocated to the auditorium due to forecasted heavy rain.
example.zh: 由於天氣預報指出將有大雨，公司夏季戶外野餐活動已改至大禮堂舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益天氣與活動延期考點：heavy rain (大雨)、rain date (雨天延期備案日期)。

example.en: The customer service hotline was unusually busy following the release of the software update.
example.zh: 在軟體更新版發布之後，客戶服務專線異常繁忙。

words.mnemonic: 繁忙期：busy season (旺季)、busy line (電話佔線通話中)。

example.en: The corporate retreat offered valuable lessons in crisis mitigation and effective team communication.
example.zh: 這場企業共識營為危機化解與高效團隊溝通提供了寶貴的經驗教訓。

words.mnemonic: 多益培訓與檢討：lessons learned (學習到的經驗教訓)。

example.en: The creative advertising department will brainstorm marketing strategies for the holiday campaign.
example.zh: 創意廣告部門將齊聚一堂進行腦力激盪，為假期促銷活動集思廣益。

words.mnemonic: 商務會議必考複合動詞：brainstorm (腦力激盪、集思廣益)。

meaning: 大眾的/大規模的(形容詞)

example.en: Mass transit subway links allow conference delegates to commute effortlessly across the city.
example.zh: 大眾捷運運輸路網讓與會代表得以毫不費力地在全城各處穿梭通勤。

words.mnemonic: 大眾普及核心詞：mass transit (大眾運輸)、mass production (大規模量產)。

example.en: The television commercial used a funny, relatable storyline to promote the new snack brand.
example.zh: 該電視廣告運用了幽默有趣且引發共鳴的故事情節來宣傳新款零食品牌。

words.mnemonic: fun (樂趣) + -y (形容詞尾) ＝ 幽默風趣的、吸睛的。

example.en: Every team member is strongly encouraged to contribute innovative ideas during the seminar.
example.zh: 大會非常鼓勵每一位團隊成員在研討會期間積極貢獻創新構想。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + tribute (給予、敬獻) ＝ 共同給予 ＝ 貢獻 (contribute to)。

example.en: Our new marketing strategy generated high customer engagement across digital platforms.
example.zh: 我們的新行銷策略在各數位平台上帶來了高度的客戶參與。

words.mnemonic: 評價指標必備詞：high quality (高品質)、high priority (高優先級)。

example.en: The sales team explored three different distribution channels to reach younger demographics.
example.zh: 銷售團隊探索了三種不同的經銷管道以觸及年輕消費族群。

words.mnemonic: 方案比較常用詞：different from (與...不同)。

example.en: All clearance items in the retail store are currently marked fifty percent off.
example.zh: 零售店內的所有清倉商品目前皆標示為半價優惠。

words.mnemonic: 促銷打折最核心用語：20% off (打八折)；take a day off (請假一天)。

example.en: The next executive board meeting will be convened on the second Tuesday of November.
example.zh: 下一次執行董事會會議將於十一月的第二個星期二召開。

words.mnemonic: 物流與時程關鍵詞：next day delivery (隔日配送)、next week (下週)。

example.en: All departments must submit their annual expenditure reports before the end of December.
example.zh: 所有部門必須在十二月底前提交年度支出報告。

words.mnemonic: 截止時間常考片語：by the end of the month (月底前)。

example.en: Many employees choose to live near the subway station to reduce their daily commute time.
example.zh: 許多員工選擇住在捷運站附近以縮短每日通勤時間。

words.mnemonic: 員工通勤生活描寫動詞；亦可作形容詞 /laɪv/ live broadcast (現場直播)。

example.en: Please keep your mobile phones on silent while the training seminar is in progress.
example.zh: 培訓研討會進行期間，請將手機保持靜音狀態。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力會場公告高頻連接詞：while + 進行中事件。

example.en: Our international freight service transports electronic parts to destinations around the world.
example.zh: 我們的國際貨運服務將電子零組件運往世界各地的目的地。

words.mnemonic: 跨國企業文宣高頻片語：around the world / throughout the world (全球各地)。

example.en: Human resources managers strive to cultivate a transparent culture free of toxic office politics.
example.zh: 人力資源經理致力於營造遠離惡性辦公室政治的透明企業文化。

reviewWords.mnemonic: polit- (城市、公民) ＝ 政治運作；office politics (辦公室政治人事角力)。

example.en: Our support center guarantees that agents will reply to client inquiries within two hours.
example.zh: 我們的客服中心保證客服專員會在兩小時之內回覆客戶諮詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + ply (折疊、回應) ＝ 回覆信函 (reply to an email)。

example.en: New retail tablet models will be prominently displayed on the front showroom floor.
example.zh: 新款零售平板電腦樣機將醒目地展示陳列在前側展廳展示區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: dis- (分開、向外) + play (展開、折疊) ＝ 展開供眾人觀看 ＝ 陳列、展示。

example.en: Her bilingual fluency and international marketing experience make her a perfect candidate for the post.
example.zh: 她的雙語流利程度與跨國行銷歷練使她成為該職位的最佳完美人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: per- (澈底) + fect (做) ＝ 澈底做完做到極致 ＝ 完美的。

example.en: Quarterly operational operating expenditures were slightly lower than preliminary financial projections.
example.zh: 第三季營業營運支出略低於原先初期的財務預算預測。

reviewWords.mnemonic: slight (輕微的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 稍微 (slightly higher / lower than)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial audit demonstrated a noticeable improvement in overall enterprise profitability.
example.zh: 企業年度財務查核報告顯示整體企業獲利能力呈現顯著改善。

reviewWords.mnemonic: over (涵蓋全部) + all (全部) ＝ 全面的、總體的 (overall performance)。

example.en: The pharmaceutical company intends to open three new medical research labs in Singapore.
example.zh: 這間製藥公司打算在新加坡設立三座新的醫藥研發實驗室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (向內) + tend (伸展、傾向) ＝ 心之所向 ＝ 打算做某事 (intend to do)。

example.en: Software engineers conducted usability testing sessions with more than two hundred active users.
example.zh: 軟體工程師與兩百多位活躍用戶共同進行了軟體易用性測試會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: use (使用) + -er (人) ＝ 軟體或產品的使用者 (user manual / experience)。

example.en: Customer service agents are required to respond to urgent complaints within one business day.
example.zh: 客服專員被要求必須在一個工作天內回應緊急客訴問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + spond (承諾、回答) ＝ 給予承諾回覆 ＝ 回應 (respond to)。

example.en: The annual corporate recognition award dinner will be hosted in the hotel grand ballroom.
example.zh: 年度企業優秀員工表揚晚宴將在飯店的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交必備：annual dinner (年終晚宴)、business dinner (商務晚宴)。

example.en: Retail commerce historically experiences a slow sales turnaround period during early February.
example.zh: 零售商業在歷史數據上往往於二月上旬經歷一段較為遲緩的銷售淡季。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 景氣或淡季常用：slow season (淡季)、slow down (減速)。

example.en: Conducting regular preventative maintenance extends the operating lifespan of factory machinery.
example.zh: 進行定期的預防性維護檢修可有效延長廠區機械設備的使用壽命。

reviewWords.mnemonic: regul- (規則) + -ar ＝ 照規則定期的 ＝ 常規的 (regular meeting)。

example.en: The retail book company maintains physical storefronts alongside a booming e-commerce platform.
example.zh: 這家連鎖書商在蓬勃發展電子商務平台的同時，依然維持著實體門市營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: physic (自然、身體) + -al ＝ 實體的 (physical store) 或健檢 (physical exam)。

example.en: Apart from minor cosmetic packaging flaws, all shipments fulfilled strict quality standards.
example.zh: 除了少數包裝上的輕微外觀瑕疵外，全數出貨均符合嚴格的品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: a- + part (部分) ＝ 各自成一部分；片語 apart from (除了...之外)。

example.en: Flexible hybrid remote hours suit the productivity needs of our digital design team.
example.zh: 彈性的混合遠距上班工時極為適合我們數位設計團隊的產能需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場服儀：business suit (商務西裝套裝)；動詞指合適 (suit one's needs)。

example.en: All domestic corporate financial statements must strictly comply with federal tax laws.
example.zh: 所有國內企業的財務報表均必須嚴格遵守聯邦稅法規定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聯邦規範與稅務：federal tax (聯邦稅)、federal regulation (聯邦法規)。

example.en: The internal corporate financial audit revealed several opportunities for cost optimization.
example.zh: 企業內部財務查核結果顯示了數個可供成本優化的絕佳機會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (反、回) + veal (面紗) ＝ 掀開面紗 ＝ 揭曉、揭露。

example.en: A significant percentage of quarterly corporate revenue is reinvested in research initiatives.
example.zh: 企業季度營收中有相當高的百分比被重新投入於研發計畫中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: percent (百分之...) + -age (名詞總稱) ＝ 百分比率。

example.en: Our comprehensive equipment warranty gives corporate clients complete peace of mind.
example.zh: 我們全面的設備保固服務為企業客戶帶來完全的安心保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷與保固文案極常見搭配：peace of mind (安心、無後顧之憂)。

example.en: Customers can track the real-time delivery status of their shipments through our portal.
example.zh: 客戶可透過我們的入口網站即時追蹤其貨物的運送處理狀態。

reviewWords.mnemonic: stat- (站立、處於) ＝ 事情目前所處的狀況 ＝ 進度狀態 (project status)。

example.en: The bank invested millions into cutting-edge cybersecurity to combat financial cybercrime.
example.zh: 該銀行斥資數百萬美元建置先進網路資安系統，以打擊金融科技犯罪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資安防護與法規考點：cybercrime (網路犯罪)、fight crime。

example.en: The regional sales manager had to decline the invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
example.zh: 該區域業務經理因行程衝突而不得不婉拒該項邀請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: de- (向下) + clin (傾斜) ＝ 向下傾斜 ＝ 下降；禮貌婉拒邀請 (decline an offer)。

example.en: Over the past decade, our automotive manufacturing company has doubled its export volume.
example.zh: 在過去十年間，我們的汽車製造公司的出口貿易量已實現翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: dec- (十) + -ade (名詞) ＝ 十年期間 (over the past decade)。

example.en: The technology startup plans to launch its flagship smartphone application next month.
example.zh: 這家科技新創公司計劃於下個月正式推出其旗艦智慧型手機應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 產品上市行銷核心詞：launch a product (發表產品)、product launch (產品發表會)。

example.en: Safety signs prominently warn plant technicians to wear protective eyewear at all times.
example.zh: 安全警示標誌醒目地提醒廠區技術人員必須隨時配戴護目鏡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞 warning (警報/警告通知)；warn someone about/of (提醒某人某事)。

example.en: Extensive consumer behavior market surveys helped guide the design of our new packaging.
example.zh: 廣泛的消費者行為市場調查引導了我們新包裝的設計方向。

reviewWords.mnemonic: consume (消費、消耗) + -er (人) ＝ 消費者 (consumer confidence / goods)。

example.en: A clear majority of board members voted in favor of the international joint venture.
example.zh: 大多數董事會成員投票贊成這項跨國合資合作案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務表決極高頻片語：in favor of (贊成、支持)；ask a favor (請求協助)。

example.en: Hotel guests may drop off executive business garments for same-day dry cleaning service.
example.zh: 飯店房客可送交商務西裝衣物以享受當日送交取件的乾洗服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務常用：dry cleaning (乾洗服務)；dry storage (乾貨常溫存放)。

example.en: We established a long-term strategic partnership with a reliable regional logistics provider.
example.zh: 我們與一家可靠的區域物流供應商建立了長期戰略合作夥伴關係。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 詢問預算與花費的固定問法：how much + 不可數名詞。

example.en: The interview panel agreed that Mr. Gomez is the right candidate for the position.
example.zh: 面試小組一致認為戈梅茲先生是擔任該職位的合適人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 招募常用 the right candidate 表最理想人選；亦有 right now (馬上)。

example.en: I am currently in a client conference, but I will call you back before five o'clock.
example.zh: 我目前正在與客戶開會，但我會在五點前回電給您。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電話商務必考片語：call back (回電)、get back to someone (回覆某人)。

example.en: The revised safety protocol means that all factory workers must wear protective helmets.
example.zh: 修訂後的安全規範意味著所有工廠作業人員皆必須配戴安全帽。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 解釋新政策或合約條款意義的常用動詞，常接 that 子句。

example.en: The newly upgraded automated system operates even faster than the previous model.
example.zh: 新升級的自動化系統運作起來甚至比先前的機型更為迅速。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 用於加強比較級語氣 (even faster) 或片語 even though (雖然)。

example.en: Please sign your name here on the receipt to acknowledge delivery of the parcel.
example.zh: 請在收據的這裡簽名，以確認已收到包裹。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 快遞簽收與櫃檯接待高頻指示副詞：sign here (在此簽名)。

example.en: Many experienced engineers attended the regional technology expo last Friday.
example.zh: 許多資深工程師上週五參加了該區域科技博覽會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 接可數複數名詞，多益聽力短對話常詢問人數或客群數量。
